description: Presidential Secretariat - Section 2 of the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40)
categorisation: The gazette content is a proclamation by the President declaring a state of public emergency and bringing specific legal provisions (Part II of the Public Security Ordinance) into operation. This constitutes the activation of a legal/regulatory framework under existing legislation, which falls squarely under the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel changes with detailed portfolios (Types 2-3), structural reorganization (Type 1), or any of the other specialized administrative matters (Types 4, 6-9).
